BRING LUXURY AND BEAUTY TO YOUR HOME
CCFF is a premium quality kitchen and bath refinishing, refacing & remodeling company bringing high-touch service & luxury designs to the greater Atlanta area for over 20 years.
Book Appointment
ONE STOP SHOP
OUR SERVICES
At CCFF we can refinish, reface or remodel.  We offer a One Stop Shop for your entire project coordinating all aspects of the job.  Our team will use our trusted project management process to keep your project on schedule and on budget.
CREATIVE CABINETS AND FINE FINISHES
Your Home. More Beautiful.
A home should reflect the way you live — effortlessly blending beauty, function, and comfort. At Creative Cabinets and Fine Finishes, we approach each project with this philosophy in mind, knowing that thoughtfully designed spaces enhance both daily living and long-term value.
Navigating a remodel can be complex, but with the right team, it becomes an inspired transformation. Through industry-leading processes, meticulous craftsmanship, and a highly personalized approach, we deliver a seamless experience — creating spaces that are as beautiful as they are functional.
REMODELING
There’s nothing quite like the moment a house becomes a home. At Creative Cabinets and Fine Finishes, we bring custom kitchen and bath designs to life through a seamless, full-service experience. Our design, project management, and installation teams work collaboratively with you from concept to completion — ensuring every detail is thoughtfully executed and your vision becomes reality.
learn more
CABINET REFINISHING & PAINTING
Your kitchen or bathroom may be ready for a refresh, but that doesn’t mean you need to replace your cabinets. If your cabinet layout and structure still work for your space, cabinet refinishing and painting can provide a beautiful transformation at a fraction of the cost of new cabinetry. At Creative Cabinets & Fine Finishes, we help homeowners give their cabinets new life with professional finishes, updated colors, and lasting craftsmanship.
learn more
CABINET REFACING
As a homeowner, you may want to update the look of your kitchen or bathroom without the expense and disruption of completely replacing your cabinets. Cabinet refacing offers the perfect solution, giving your space a fresh new appearance while keeping your existing cabinet boxes in place. At Creative Cabinets & Fine Finishes, our cabinet refacing experts can transform your kitchen or bathroom with new doors, drawer fronts, hardware, and a professionally finished look.
learn more
CLIENT TESTIMONIALS
Client reviews are not only important to our team, but they also play a vital role in helping potential clients make informed decisions. They provide valuable feedback, build trust, and showcase our dedication to delivering exceptional services.
As for Creative Cabinets, client reviews serve as a valuable feedback mechanism. They help gauge our performance, identify areas for improvement, and understand the specific needs and preferences of our clients. The feedback allows us to continuously refine our processes and deliver even better results!

CUSTOM LAUNDRY ROOM CABINETS, REMODELS, AND MAKEOVERS
Let Creative Cabinets and Fine Finishes help you transform one of the busiest areas in your home…The Laundry Room. We offer custom designs for all budgets and have custom and semi-custom cabinets with a range of storage ideas. As a woman owned business, we understand the importance of a well-organized laundry room. We believe in creating a space that has designated areas for all your daily tasks.
Often the laundry room project turns into a mudroom project as folks are trying to figure out where to put their stuff. From kids’ sports storage, backpacks, lacrosse sticks, soccer balls, coats, and shoes this can be overwhelming. With clever design and storage ideas, we can make the task of keeping your home organized and less daunting.
Countertops are now common in laundry rooms and offer a great folding space for linens and clothes. Baskets are also important as they help for easy sorting of laundry items.
We are also seeing a lot of homeowners adding dog showers and bath areas as well as adding storage for dog food as dogs continue to be an intricate part of any family.
CCFF can also help with all the electric placement needed as charging drawers and stations are becoming more and more common in our industry as we all have multiple devices we are all using daily.
You will receive unparalleled service from a company in business now for 15 years and has 100’s of online reviews.

WE CAN MAKE YOUR DOORS & DRAWERS LOCALLY
Are you in need of new cabinet doors or drawers, but don't want to spend the extra money to get them installed? We grant free quotes for finished or unfinished doors, drawer faces & drawer boxes that can be delivered to the job site or picked up at our facility in Marietta GA! Our team can make various cabinet door styles & sizes for any room in your home. Additionally, our skilled carpenters can make new custom drawer boxes, custom pullouts, & crown molding. Even if it's as simple as purchasing a few new cabinet doors, you will receive guidance throughout production. By using the best professionals, materials and methods, all of our
kitchen and bath woodworking
projects are completed with the customer’s satisfaction in mind.
whos our target market?everyone!
Whether you are a builder, house flipper, homeowner, rental property owner, real estate agent, or interior designer, this is for you! You have the option to purchase all new doors in various styles & sizes for your space, & pick them up with almost no lead time!
what all can we make?
» Cabinet doors in many styles (unfinished or finished)
» Drawer faces in many styles (unfinished or finished)
» Dovetail drawer boxes
» Custom pullouts and new custom drawers

» Very quick turnaround time
» Option for pick-up or delivery

» If you'd rather the door faces come finished, we can paint them for you!

One Kitchen, Two Transformations
by Evan Hill//
August 18
A Kitchen That Evolved Over Time
Some kitchen transformations happen all at once—this one came together in two parts. We first worked with these homeowners to brighten their existing kitchen through professional cabinet refinishing and a remodeled island. Later that same year, they were ready to take the transformation even further, returning to CCFF for new countertops, backsplash, and additional updates that brought the entire space together.
BEFORE | A Traditional Kitchen Ready for a Change
The original kitchen featured rich brown cabinetry, granite countertops, a coordinating tile backsplash, and a dark island. While the existing layout offered plenty of cabinetry and functional storage, the darker finishes made the room feel heavier and more traditional. Rather than replacing everything, the homeowners’ first goal was to brighten and update the space while making use of many of the kitchen’s existing elements.
PHASE ONE | Cabinet Refinishing + Island Transformation
The kitchen’s first transformation centered around creating a lighter, brighter look. The existing brown cabinetry was professionally refinished in white, immediately changing the feel of the entire room. The perimeter granite countertops and backsplash remained, allowing the homeowners to make a significant visual update without undergoing a complete remodel.
The island received a larger transformation. It was modified and finished in a soft blue tone, creating contrast against the newly white cabinetry, and topped with a fresh white quartz countertop. The combination introduced a lighter, more current color palette while giving the island a distinct presence at the center of the kitchen. This first phase shows just how dramatically cabinet refinishing and a few strategic updates can transform an existing space.
PHASE TWO | Finishing Touches
When the homeowners were ready to update their kitchen again, they returned to CCFF to take the transformation even further. This time, the project expanded beyond the cabinetry and island. New white quartz countertops were carried throughout the kitchen, replacing the original granite and creating a brighter, more cohesive surface from the perimeter to the island. The original backsplash was also replaced with a blue tile installed in an offset pattern, introducing subtle color, texture, and movement while tying into the blue island. Under-cabinet lighting was added to illuminate the new backsplash and countertops, bringing another layer of warmth and functionality to the space.
These homeowners love to cook, so we took the original stainless steel backsplash behind the range and extended it across the surrounding wall, creating a durable, easy-to-clean surface.
At the bookshelf and cabinet wall, strategically placed lighting emphasizes the unique shape, open shelving, and architectural details, allowing this custom feature to stand out even more.
The island gained a practical upgrade with a built-in pull-out trash system, keeping everyday functionality conveniently tucked away and maintaining the kitchen’s clean, streamlined design.
Details We Love:
Bright white cabinetry
Soft blue island that adds contrast and character
White quartz countertops carried throughout the finished space
Blue offset tile backsplash for subtle color and movement
Under-cabinet lighting
Stainless steel backsplash extended across the range wall for a clean, cohesive look
Functional storage incorporated into the remodeled island
A transformation completed in two distinct phases
A Remodel That Worked With Their Budget
One of the unique aspects of this project was the homeowners’ decision to divide their kitchen transformation into two phases, allowing them to make meaningful updates while working within their budget. By starting with cabinet refinishing and an island transformation, then completing the remaining updates in a second phase, they were able to achieve the finished kitchen they envisioned on a timeline and budget that worked for them.
At CCFF, we understand that every homeowner’s priorities and budget are different. Our team works with clients to explore options and create a plan that makes sense for their home, whether that means completing a transformation all at once or thoughtfully approaching it in phases.
From the Original Kitchen to Today
Looking at all three stages side by side shows just how much this kitchen has evolved, from its original dark wood finishes, to a bright cabinet refinish and statement island, to the polished, fully remodeled space it is today. What makes this project especially meaningful is having the opportunity to work with the same homeowners through multiple chapters of their home. Their first project gave the kitchen an entirely new look, and their return to CCFF allowed us to build upon that transformation and create a space that better reflects their style today.
Designed by: Carla Schmidt
Carla is a passionate and innovative designer that specializes in bathroom design known for transforming functional spaces into luxurious retreats. Specializing in creating both aesthetically pleasing and highly functional bathrooms with timeless elegance to suit every client’s unique vision. Drawing inspiration from both modern and classic styles, Carla crafts designs that enhance comfort and elevate the space.  Her attention to detail and ability to optimize space ensure each project is executed to perfection. From layout and materials to lighting and fixtures, Carla works closely with clients to create bathrooms that blend beauty, practicality, and personal style.

Thinking about selling your home? Before you remodel, it’s worth asking: which improvements will actually matter to a future buyer?
Not every renovation is going to give you the same return, and spending more doesn’t necessarily mean getting more back when it’s time to sell.
Kitchens and bathrooms are often high-impact spaces because buyers notice when they feel dated or don’t function well. Improving curb appeal can also make a difference before a buyer even walks through the front door. But that doesn’t mean you need to completely transform these spaces. Smaller, targeted updates can sometimes make more sense than a full, high-end renovation when your goal is to improve the home before selling.
On the other hand, highly personalized upgrades or major renovations that go far beyond what’s typical for the neighborhood may not recoup their full cost at resale. If an improvement is designed around very specific tastes or adds features that future buyers may not value in the same way, you may not see that investment reflected in the sale price.
The key is knowing what makes sense for your home, your market, and your timeline before you start making decisions.

The entryway stays clearer, the kitchen counter stays less cluttered, the dog’s leash is always in the same place, and getting out the door becomes just a little easier.

That’s exactly the kind of thinking we’ll be exploring at our upcoming seminar, Basements & Multi-Rooms: Transforming Underused Spaces Into Favorite Rooms.

Join our award-winning designers on September 19 at 10 AM for creative ideas for making more of the space you already have, including mudrooms, home offices, finished basements, and multi-room transformations.

If your home has a space that could work harder for your family, come get inspired. Register through the link in our bio and join us September 19!

Does your house have that one room nobody knows what to do with?

Maybe it’s the extra bedroom you don’t really need, or the awkward bonus room, or the space that somehow became a dumping ground for everything without a designated home. Even though you have no idea what to do with them right now, these are all underutilized spaces that are brimming with potential.

All that room needs is a little imagination and some intentional thinking.

Take this space for example. It had the potential to be a lot of things, but when the clients spoke about their lifestyle, it made sense to dedicate the space as a home office. Since both parties needed space to work, his-and-hers workstations made sense to create dedicated spaces to focus, while the generous layout keeps the room feeling open and comfortable.

Underused spaces don’t have to stay that way. In fact, we’ll be talking all about this at our upcoming complimentary seminar, Basements & Multi-Rooms: Transforming Underused Spaces Into Favorite Rooms.

Join our award-winning designers on September 19 at 10 AM as they share creative ideas for turning overlooked spaces into rooms you actually want to use, from home offices and mudrooms to finished basements and multi-room transformations.

Have a room you’re not sure what to do with? Come get inspired. Register through the link in our bio and join us September 19!

Why should laundry always live in the basement?

If most of your laundry happens upstairs, carrying baskets up and down the stairs can become one of those everyday inconveniences you simply learn to live with. But you don’t necessarily need a huge laundry room to make that routine easier.

A smaller laundry area tucked onto the second floor can put everything right where you need it. A compact washer and dryer can fit into a surprisingly small footprint, and thoughtful additions like a sink for stain treatment or dedicated storage can make the space even more functional.

This kind of setup isn’t just useful for a second-floor laundry area either. A compact laundry unit can be a smart solution for in-law suites or accessory dwelling units, where space is often limited but having everyday conveniences close at hand can make a big difference. Instead of dedicating an entire room to laundry, you can create a functional setup that fits neatly into the space you have while still giving you the independence and convenience of having laundry right where you need it.

That’s exactly the kind of thinking we’ll be exploring at our upcoming seminar, Basements & Multi-Rooms: Transforming Underused Spaces Into Favorite Rooms.

Join our award-winning designers on September 19 at 10 am for creative ideas and practical solutions for making more of the space you already have, whether you’re dreaming about a finished basement, a home office, a mudroom, or a better-functioning multi-room layout.

The seminar is complimentary, but seating is limited and pre-registration is required. Have a space in your home that isn’t being used to its full potential? Come get inspired. Register through the link in our bio and join us September 19!

When you think about the return on investment of a remodel, you probably think about resale value.

And yes, that’s certainly part of it; a thoughtfully designed kitchen or bathroom can add value to your home. But we’d actually argue that the return you’re getting every day is just as important.

Maybe it’s the 10 minutes you get back every morning because your bathroom finally works for your routine. Or maybe it’s not having to dig through three cabinets to find the coffee maker, filters, and coffee beans. Or being able to cook dinner without bumping into everyone else in the kitchen and then sitting down in a space that cultivates conversation. It could even be something as simple as walking into a room that feels calm instead of cluttered.

Those moments don’t have a dollar amount attached to them, but they all have value. Think about how much time a functional layout saves. Thoughtful storage reduces frustration and a space designed around the way you actually live makes everyday life a little easier. 

We’d also be remiss if we didn’t bring up the joy of finally having a home that feels like it’s yours. A remodel allows you to customize the space to be suited to your needs: A kitchen where everyone naturally gathers or a bathroom that feels like a retreat.

Investing in your home doesn’t have to be about maximizing what you’ll get back when you sell. You deserve to enjoy the investment while you live there, too.

If you’ve been hesitating because you’re not sure whether a remodel is “worth it,” maybe the better question is: what would it be worth to you to stop working around your home and start having it work for you? Our designers can help you figure that out. Schedule a complimentary consultation through the link in our bio and let’s talk about what your home could give back to you.

Our Process
We’re obsessed with every detail in our four-step Design/Build process. Our team of experts will manage every aspect of your project from idea to completion to ensure your remodel exceeds your expectations.
Imagine
We start with questions. Why? Because we want to truly understand your lifestyle and how you’ll use your new space. Then, we’ll visit your home to measure and discuss ideas with your budget in mind.
Conceptualize
Gain a true picture of the possibilities! Next, we’ll meet in our Design Center to present design concepts with our 3D modeling software to see how your new space could look and feel. We’ll review the scope of work and adjust based upon your needs. Our Project Development Agreement outlines selected concepts and budget, so you can move forward with detailed design and product selections.
Collaborate
With your feedback, we’ll transform your concepts into detailed plans and guide you through the myriad of product choices to prepare the roadmap for your new space. We’ll be by your side as you select everything from cabinetry, countertops, to plumbing fixtures, flooring, lighting, accessories and more. Construction documents are finalized and then the fun begins!
Build
Let’s make it happen!
Our skilled craftspeople are constantly training and updating their skills in all areas including carpentry, plumbing, electrical, flooring and lighting to ensure your project is completed to the highest level of quality and industry standards. You’ll be introduced to your installation team and they’ll review every detail of the buildout with you before construction even begins. All materials are ordered, received, and inspected at our facility and then our team is ready to install. Your satisfaction is always guaranteed, and we’ll will treat your home with the utmost care, always maintaining a clean and orderly worksite.

About Us
As a family-owned, full-service Design Build residential remodeler, we are renowned for our nationally award-winning work in kitchens, baths, mudrooms, pantries, built-ins, multi-room renovations, game rooms, bar areas, and more.
We specialize in creating spaces that cater to various life stages, from raising families and entertaining friends to providing for loved ones or facilitating aging in place. We take pride in meeting our clients exactly where they are in life. We find immense joy in our direct impact on people’s lives as they welcome us into their homes and trust us to uphold our promises.
Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in RI by Providence Business News from 2018 to 2024 and the only Rhode Island contractor on the Remodeling 550 list (honoring America’s largest remodelers), we have earned a reputation for quality craftsmanship and exceptional style. We are fully committed to customer satisfaction.
We invite you to explore our expansive 3,000-square-foot showroom at 139 Jefferson Boulevard, Warwick, RI. Discover full-size displays of the latest trends in appliances, countertops, cabinetry hardware, tile, plumbing, lighting, and more. Don’t miss our complimentary remodeling seminars, designed to inspire with new product innovations, styles, and trends.
Our Story
Since we opened our doors in 1989, we have earned a reputation as the leading Rhode Island kitchen and bathroom remodeling company. Our Design+Build approach gives us a distinct advantage over other general contractors. Where other companies only offer limited services, we take a complete approach to every job, overseeing the planning, designing, and installation of every project. This gives us better control over scheduling, quality and costs, and results in a project that is completed with fewer delays and – a very important consideration – less stress for our customers!
A Little History
From the very beginning, we have an emphasis on hiring talented people with a passion for remodeling and designing, and a desire to please customers. Over the years, we have built a team of professionals who are among the most skilled and experienced in the industry. We continue to emphasize training and skill building, and several of our Design Consultants have become Certified Kitchen & Bath (CKD) designers as well as Certified Aging in Place Specialists (CAPS). We have also been certified by the EPA as a LeadSafe contractor. Our passion for professionalism and commitment to customer satisfaction has led the company to be the leading design/build company in the area.
An Unparalleled Guarantee
We are so confident in our work that every project is guaranteed for a full five years with our Quality Assurance and Five-Year Workmanship Warranty. This is on top of the manufacturer warranties that accompany many of the products we install. No remodeling company can deliver the peace of mind that comes with such a strong guarantee.

About RIKB Design Build
What is RIKB Design Build?
RIKB Design Build is an award-winning residential design-build remodeling company serving homeowners throughout Rhode Island, southeastern Massachusetts, and eastern Connecticut. Since 1989, we’ve specialized in kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, home additions, basement finishing, and whole-home renovations. Our integrated design-build process brings design, project management, and construction together under one experienced team.
What is a design-build remodeling company?
A design-build company manages every phase of a remodeling project, from design and material selection to construction and project management. Instead of hiring separate designers, architects, and contractors, homeowners work with a single coordinated team throughout the project.
What types of remodeling projects does RIKB Design Build specialize in?
RIKB Design Build specializes in custom residential remodeling, including kitchen and bathroom remodels, whole-home renovations, basement finishing, home additions, mudrooms, laundry rooms, home offices, built-ins, and aging-in-place renovations. Whether you’re updating a single room or transforming your entire home, our design-build team creates beautiful, functional spaces tailored to your lifestyle and goals.
What areas does RIKB Design Build serve for home remodeling?
RIKB Design Build proudly serves homeowners throughout Rhode Island, southeastern Massachusetts, and eastern Connecticut from our Warwick, Rhode Island, Design Center. If you’re planning a kitchen remodel, bathroom renovation, home addition, or whole-home remodel, our team can help determine whether your project falls within our service area.
Why should I choose RIKB Design Build for my remodeling project?
For nearly four decades, RIKB Design Build has helped homeowners throughout Rhode Island create beautiful, functional spaces tailored to their lifestyles. Our collaborative design-build process, experienced team, exceptional craftsmanship, and commitment to customer satisfaction deliver a full-service remodeling experience that is organized, transparent, and enjoyable from the first design meeting through the final walkthrough.
How do I get started with RIKB Design Build?
Getting started is easy. Schedule a consultation with our design team to discuss your goals, lifestyle, investment range, and vision for your home. We’ll answer your questions, explain our design-build process, and help you determine the best path forward for your remodeling project.
Can I visit your Design Center before starting my remodeling project?
Absolutely! We encourage it. Whether you’re just gathering ideas or ready to start planning, visiting our 3,000+ square-foot Design Center in Warwick, Rhode Island, is a great first step toward bringing your vision to life. Explore inspiring displays of kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces while comparing cabinetry, countertops, tile, flooring, lighting, plumbing fixtures, and other finishes, all in one place. Our experienced designers are available to answer your questions, offer expert guidance, and help you make confident selections that fit your style, lifestyle, and budget.
How does your remodeling process work?
Our proven four-step design-build process guides your project from concept to completion, with a single experienced team managing every detail. We begin by learning about your home, lifestyle, and goals. Next, our designers create custom plans and 3D renderings and guide you through selecting materials and finishes in our Design Center. Once the design and plans are finalized, our skilled craftspeople and project managers oversee construction, keeping your project on schedule and maintaining clear communication every step of the way. Our Four-Step Process:
Imagine: We learn how you live and explore ideas that fit your space and budget
Conceptualize: See your space come to life with 3D designs and a clear scope of work
Collaborate: Make selections and finalize plans with expert guidance at every step
Build: Your dream becomes reality – crafted with care, quality, and respect for your home.
Does RIKB Design Build offer remodeling seminars?
Yes. RIKB Design Build offers complimentary remodeling seminars throughout the year to help homeowners plan with confidence. Led by our award-winning designers, these educational sessions cover remodeling trends, design ideas, budgeting, and what to expect during the remodeling process. Guests can meet our team, explore our 3,000+ square foot Design Center, and gain valuable insights before starting their project.
Does RIKB Design Build remodel historic homes in Rhode Island?
Yes. RIKB Design Build has extensive experience remodeling homes of all ages, including many of the area’s historic and character-filled properties. Our team thoughtfully blends modern functionality with timeless design, preserving the unique architectural details that make older homes special while updating them to better support today’s lifestyles.
Does RIKB Design Build work on coastal homes?
Yes. RIKB Design Build has completed remodeling projects in many of Rhode Island’s coastal communities. Whether you’re updating a year-round residence or a seasonal home, our team understands the importance of choosing durable materials, maximizing natural light and views, and creating spaces that complement the coastal lifestyle.
Planning a Remodeling Project
Should I remodel or move?
Many homeowners love their neighborhood but need a home that better fits their lifestyle. Remodeling can often deliver the updated layout, functionality, and comfort you want while letting you stay where you are. Strategic renovations, such as kitchen remodels, bathroom updates, additions, or reconfigured living spaces, can improve your home’s livability and long-term value. If you enjoy your location but your home no longer meets your needs, remodeling may be a smart investment that helps you love your home again without the expense and disruption of moving.
When is the best time to remodel my home?
The best time to remodel is when your home no longer meets your needs and you’re ready to improve your lifestyle. While many homeowners begin planning in the winter or spring, remodeling projects happen year-round. Starting the planning process early gives you more flexibility in scheduling, design, and material selections, helping your project move more smoothly from concept to completion.
How much should I budget for a home remodel?
The cost of a home remodel depends on the project’s size, scope of work, materials you choose, and the level of customization. Whether you’re remodeling a single room or your entire home, it’s helpful to set an investment range early in the planning process. During your consultation, our team will discuss your goals, priorities, and budget to develop a design that delivers the greatest value for your investment.
How long does a remodeling project take?
Every remodeling project is unique, so the timeline depends on the size, scope, and complexity of the work. Smaller projects may take just a few weeks, while larger renovations or additions typically take longer. During the design phase, we’ll develop a realistic project schedule and keep you informed every step of the way. Because every detail, from design and product selections to construction planning, is finalized before work begins, our design-build process helps minimize delays and keeps your project moving as smoothly as possible.
Why choose a local Rhode Island remodeling company?
Choosing a local remodeling company means working with a team that understands the area’s homes, architecture, building codes, and permitting requirements. With more than 35 years of experience serving homeowners, RIKB Design Build has built strong relationships with trusted local suppliers and craftsmen and has earned a reputation for quality, communication, and exceptional customer service. Our local expertise helps ensure a smoother remodeling experience from start to finish.
Kitchen Remodeling
What adds the most value to a kitchen remodel?
The most valuable kitchen remodels enhance everyday functionality and long-term home value. Features such as an efficient layout, quality cabinetry, durable countertops, a spacious island, ample storage, and layered lighting can make your kitchen more enjoyable and increase its appeal to future buyers. The best investment is one that supports how your family lives while complementing your home’s style.
Is an open-concept kitchen right for my home?
Open-concept kitchens remain among the most popular remodeling choices because they improve flow, increase natural light, and make cooking, entertaining, and time with family easier. However, the best layout depends on your home’s architecture, your lifestyle, and how you use the space. A thoughtful kitchen design should balance openness with storage, functionality, and defined living areas.
What kitchen design trends never go out of style?
Timeless kitchen design prioritizes quality materials and thoughtful planning over short-lived trends. Neutral cabinetry, natural stone or quartz countertops, layered lighting, functional storage, and classic finishes create a kitchen that will look beautiful for years. Choosing durable materials and a layout that supports your daily routine helps ensure your investment stands the test of time.
Are custom cabinets worth the investment?
For many homeowners, custom cabinetry is one of the most worthwhile investments in a kitchen remodel. Custom cabinets maximize storage, improve organization, and are tailored to your space and lifestyle. They also offer greater flexibility in style, finishes, and functionality, helping you create a kitchen that looks beautiful and functions efficiently for years to come.
Bathroom Remodeling
What should I include in a bathroom remodel?
The best bathroom remodels balance style, comfort, and functionality. Popular upgrades include larger walk-in showers, double vanities, improved lighting, additional storage, durable countertops, updated fixtures, and better ventilation. Many homeowners also opt for features such as heated floors, built-in shower niches, and water-efficient fixtures. Prioritizing how you use the space daily will help create a bathroom that is both beautiful and practical.
What is a curbless shower?
A curbless shower is a walk-in shower with no raised threshold between the bathroom floor and the shower area. This seamless design creates a clean, modern look and makes the space feel larger and easier to access. Curbless showers are a popular choice for homeowners planning to age in place because they improve accessibility without sacrificing style. They can also make cleaning easier and add a luxurious, spa-like feel to your bathroom.
What bathroom features add the most value to a home?
Bathrooms that blend timeless design with everyday functionality typically deliver the greatest long-term value. Popular upgrades include walk-in showers, quality vanities, durable countertops, updated lighting, efficient storage, and water-saving fixtures. Choosing classic materials and a thoughtful layout can enhance both your daily routine and your home’s resale appeal.
Design-Build Process
What is the difference between remodeling and renovating?
Although the terms are often used interchangeably, remodeling involves changing a space’s layout, function, or design, while renovating focuses on updating or restoring what’s already there. For example, replacing cabinets and moving walls constitute a remodel, whereas refinishing floors or updating fixtures without changing the layout is a renovation.
Why should I choose a design-build company instead of a traditional contractor?
A design-build company brings design, budgeting, project management, and construction together under one team, creating a more streamlined remodeling experience. Instead of coordinating multiple professionals, you’ll have a single point of contact from concept through completion. This collaborative approach improves communication, helps keep projects on schedule and within budget, and ensures your design vision is carried through every phase of the remodel.
What happens during the design phase?
The design phase is where your vision begins to take shape. You’ll work closely with your designer to develop floor plans, review 3D renderings, select cabinetry, countertops, tile, lighting, fixtures, and other finishes, and establish your project scope and budget. Finalizing these details before construction begins helps minimize surprises and ensures everyone is working toward the same vision.
Why is planning important before a remodeling project begins?
Careful planning is one of the most important steps in a successful remodel. Finalizing the design, selecting materials, setting a realistic budget, and preparing construction plans before work begins help reduce delays, avoid unexpected costs, and create a smoother experience from start to finish. At RIKB, we believe thoughtful planning leads to better results and happier homeowners.
Aging in Place
&
Universal Design
What is aging-in-place remodeling?
Aging-in-place remodeling integrates thoughtful design features that help homeowners stay safe, comfortable, and independent as their needs change over time. Popular upgrades include curbless showers, wider doorways, improved lighting, non-slip flooring, comfort-height fixtures, and first-floor living spaces. These enhancements not only improve accessibility but also create a home that is functional and beautiful for years to come.
What is universal design?
Universal design is an approach to home design that creates spaces that are comfortable, functional, and accessible for people of all ages and abilities. Features such as wider walkways, lever-style door handles, easy-to-reach storage, improved lighting, and barrier-free entries make a home easier to use without sacrificing style. Whether you’re planning for the future or simply want a more livable home today, universal design helps create spaces that work for everyone.

Community Service
At RIKB, corporate social responsibility is part of our DNA.  From our employees, to partners, to clients and potential clients, we encourage everyone to give back. Whether through their time, contributions, or donating used building materials, here are a few of the organizations we support.
Potter League for Animals
The Potter League for Animals is Rhode Island’s go-to animal care and resource center, where we provide shelter, veterinary care, behavior training, spay & neuter, owner assistance programs, humane education, and the opportunity for thousands of animals to find loving homes each year.
Visit Site
Habitat for Humanity ReSTORES
ReStore is a non-profit home improvement store and donation center that sells new and gently used furniture, building materials, appliances and home accessories to the public at a fraction of the retail price. With help from local donors, shoppers and volunteers, proceeds from ReStore sales are used to build homes in South County and around the world!
Visit Site
EcoBuilding Bargains
EcoBuilding Bargains is the largest used building materials store in New England offering deals on re-used and surplus materials, including cabinets, architectural salvage, lumber, doors, windows, tile, appliances, lighting fixtures, and furniture. Their mission is to help New England home owners stay green by keeping thousands of tons of useful materials out of landfills. EcoBuilding Bargains accepts donations of quality, but unwanted, home improvement materials and sells them to the public at low prices in a convenient retail setting.

Rhode Island Community Food Bank
Since 1982, the Rhode Island Community Food Bank has been distributing millions of pounds of food to those in need of assistance through our network of member agencies across the state. We love sup-porting this organization and assisting our neighbors across Rhode Island. At all of the seminars we host throughout the year, accept food donations from attendees and are proud to provide monetary do-nations on behalf our of clients throughout the year.

Toys for Tots
The U. S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots Program collects new, unwrapped toys during October, November and December each year, and distribute those toys as Christmas gifts to less fortunate children in the community. We agree that every child deserves a little Christmas. That’s why, year after year, our design center is always on the list of drop off locations.

License

Insurance
When looking for the best remodeling company to hire for your remodeling project, we urge you to consider several criteria in order to judge the stability and ability of your contractor. Two important factors that remodeling company should have in place are proper licensing and sufficient insurance.
A contractor who is not licensed to do business can easily disappear once a job is finished, leaving you to deal with any problems that arise. Worse, an unlicensed contractor could take your deposit and “fly the coop” before the work is done, leaving you with an unfinished kitchen or bathroom. Licensing demonstrates stability and accountability on the part of the contractor.
RIKB Design Build is a licensed and insured contractor in Rhode Island (Reg#3984), Massachusetts (MA#164199) and Connecticut (CT#HIC.0673137). Rhode Island Kitchen & Bath carries liability insurance up to $2 million for each project, as well as full worker’s compensation insurance for all staff members.
Similarly, a legitimate remodeling company will carry both liability insurance and workers’ compensation insurance. Without this coverage, any accident or injury that occurs in your home may become your liability! Make sure any contractor you are considering has current liability and workers’ compensation coverage. Insist on getting a Certificate of Insurance directly from the company’s insurance carrier.

We’ve always made continued learning a core value. We believe that it’s crucial to hone our skills and stay current with industry and design best practices. That’s why we encourage all of our employees to further develop and improve themselves through company-paid ongoing training through certifications, educational workshops and/or industry conferences. All employees are provided with a continuing education and certification annual allowance and encouraged to utilize these funds. Our design staff is encouraged to pursue certifications including CAPS (Certified Aging in Place), UDCP (Universal Design Certified Professional), CKD (Certified Kitchen Designer), and AKBD (Associate Kitchen & Bath Designer) and our field personally attend OSHA safety classes. We also encourage our team to learn from each other through mentoring, job shadowing and cross training.
